_note: The hunter specialty bar (game/specialty.rs, ui/hud.rs): four slots numbered 6 to 9, separate from the five common hotbar slots (HOTBAR_SIZE). A slot is visible while one of its `hunters` exists on the current floor (whatever the hunter's state); its item is granted when it becomes visible and REMOVED (not returned to the pack) when it stops being visible. `key` is the macroquad key code name that selects the slot (browser digit row Digit6..Digit9 arrive as Key6..Key9). `kind`: music_box (the wound box, Glyra), temperature (ONE shared heat/cold item for Wynelle and Solyth), empty (a reserved slot, drawn empty, no item). `temperature` is the real effect of the shared item: heat warms the body toward `target_offset` degrees up to `cap` and counts as a heater for Wynelle (she cannot gather and a materialised Wynelle thaws away); cold cools the body by `target_offset` down to `floor`, slows Solyth by `solyth_slow_factor` and reads the runner below `solyth_pounce_reading` degrees so her pounce gate (60) stays shut. Design: KT 2026-11-06.
